statement: Reverse Curve (Curve > Util): Reverse direction
superiority: Curve utilities with reported deviation and tolerance, stable output ordering and no silent type changes.
notes: Single research pass from public documentation knowledge; network to doc sites was blocked, so the component name and tab placement still need verification against the Rhino 8 component index and the URL in source.doc. Acceptance sketch: Start/end swapped | w0-rw5-ghgeo: node(s) Reverse Curve (changed; the name is shared with the Blender Geometry Nodes node, one registry entry, in FlowNodesBlender2.cpp) in dino8-app/src/flow/FlowNodesCurve.cpp; app section GREV (dino8-app/tests/sections/97_grev.sh, generated by dino8-app/tests/flowgeo_gen.py) asserts against independent closed forms: the line (1,2,3)->(4,6,3) reversed starts at (4,6,3) and ends at (1,2,3), has the same length 5 and the middle (2.5,4,3) with unit tangent (-0.6,-0.8,0) (it was (0.6,0.8,0)); the circle of radius 2 at the origin starts at (2,0,0) both ways, its tangent there (0,1,0) turns into (0,-1,0) and a quarter of the way round is (0,-2,0) instead of (0,2,0); the polyline (0,0,0),(4,0,0),(4,3,0) reversed starts at (4,3,0), ends at (0,0,0) and one unit along from its start is (4,2,0). Values are compared as round((value - closed form) * 1e9) = 0, i.e. within 5e-10, inside the row's 1e-9 tolerance; each section also reports two controls (a closed form off by 1e-6 reads -1000, Square(2) against 4.5 reads -500000000) and a presence check wherever the closed form is 0, so a failed node cannot match. A poly spline keeps the point-order path that the Blender rows BFREV, BFFILL and BFISCY pin (they still pass); any other curve (a circle, an arc, a higher-degree spline) was resampled to 256 points and is now reversed exactly (start and end swapped, tangent turned round). Unverified until CI evidence.
